🌞 To all of Ruben Gallego’s supporters: 🌵
September 30th is our final full FEC deadline before November. This month is a time when Ruben really, really needs your support.
But the truth is, the vast majority of people who read this email won’t give; they’ll look the other way. We’re hoping you’re different.

As a matter of fact, _we need you to be different._
During his campaign for U.S. Senate, millions of people signed on to support Ruben. But of those millions, less than 5% ever made a donation to power his campaign. That’s 5% of Ruben’s supporters with skin in the game.

Today, we’re asking you to join that important group.
You might not believe it, but the vast majority of the donations Ruben receives come from emails like this one, and people like you chipping in what they can, when they can.
That’s why we need your help. We’re passionate about the way we fundraise because it lets Ruben focus on what really matters — fighting for people and not special interests. But with this final FEC period officially kicking off, the pressure is on.

So, if holding Trump and the GOP accountable, fighting back in Arizona and around the country, and supporting the candidates who will win back the House and Senate matters to you, please:

We’re building something special here in North Carolina.
Hundreds of thousands of folks who care about the future of this country – just like you – are joining our grassroots movement to fix what’s broken in Washington DC and return power to working people. Because of you, momentum is on our side.
**However, news just broke that a super PAC aligned with President Trump is going to invest millions to try to buy this seat for my opponent, Michael Whatley, so all of the progress we’ve made together could soon be wiped out entirely.**

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: A little worried
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
I know it's late, but my mind is racing thinking about these Senate Leadership Fund ads.
Peter,
I know it's late, but my mind is racing thinking about these Senate Leadership Fund ads — called “SLF” for short.
SLF is a Super PAC with a sole focus on electing Republicans to the Senate. **By Election Day, they will have spent $51 million — possibly more — on Michigan alone.**
Just like the $70 million we were up against in the primary, it’s hard to even fathom that amount of money.
But despite how scary that sounds, I still believe we’re going to win in November. Here’s why:
The Senate Leadership Fund has run this playbook before, in races just like ours. It spends millions trying to bury campaigns that won't play by its rules — and in almost every one of those races, one of two scenarios plays out:
1. When a campaign has the resources to tell its own story and break through the noise, SLF's ads don't land.
2. When a campaign runs dry, gets overwhelmed, and can't respond, that's when the ads seal their fate.

So the honest answer to whether we get to defy the odds once again in November isn't complicated. **It comes down to whether we have enough grassroots power to keep running our own ads, reaching our own voters, and holding onto our story before SLF defines it for us.**
Peter, I fully trust that our team has what it takes to out-maneuver and out-organize $51+ million. I've put my faith in you since the very beginning, and you've never let me down.
**I wouldn't be writing to you this late if I didn't believe what you do tonight matters to what happens in this race.** So please, if you can pitch in $5 or any amount so we can keep our ads on the air and our story in our own hands, it would make a real difference. Can I count on your support?
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20260913-3-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260913-3-ak.X2Ey07&amount=5&refcode=em20260815-3171&t=2&akid=3171%2E251025%2EUzR4fX)
Thank you, truly.
Abdul

clean_body: We need to get ahead, and stay ahead. Peter, I've been through a lot of end-of-quarter deadlines over the years. But this one feels different. This is our last end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. And this November, voters have two options: allow Trump and his Republican-controlled Congress to continue governing with unchecked, reckless power—or put a check on this disastrous administration. When the books close at the end of September, there won't be another quarter to make up ground. There won't be another major fundraising deadline before voters make their choice. Ballots in Washington drop in mid-October. It'll just be the final sprint to November, and I won't pretend I'm not feeling the weight of that. There is so much at stake this year. Everything we've worked for—like fighting to protect healthcare, defending reproductive freedom, lowering costs for families, and standing up to the chaos coming out of Washington, DC—is on the line in this election. I want to go into these final weeks knowing we did everything we possibly could to turn out the vote and win back the biggest possible Democratic House majority. ** Jonny’s Team Needs YOU 🫵
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Friend,

It’s hard to believe that 25 years have passed since September 11, 2001. For those of us who lived through that day, the memories can still feel remarkably close, where we were, who we were with, and how the world seemed to change in an instant. For Jonny, those memories are especially personal, tied to his time serving with the US Marine Corps in Washington, D.C. As we mark this anniversary, he reflects on what he witnessed that morning, the service and sacrifice that followed, and the sense of unity Americans shared in the days after.

Read the press release (https://jonnyutah4congress.com/latest-news/press-releases/september-11-2026-remembrance-press-release?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=3b8275af7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=3b8275af7d&mc_eid=UNIQID) , or watch Jonny share his memories and some memorabilia here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=emLtrA_Cw6A&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=3b8275af7d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=3b8275af7d&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: About my decision
disclaimer_text: paid for by men who do not care what happens to working families across America
body:
There is a more urgent decision in front of us, and it will be made in 50 days.
I know there’s a lot of speculation right now about what I’ll decide to do in 2028. I get asked about it in nearly every interview and at every event. In some ways, I understand the interest. But I wanted to write to you today to be direct about what I’m focused on.
Frankly, I could not care less about titles or positions for myself. That’s not why I got into this work. What matters to me is changing this country so that it finally works for all of us, and that’s why my focus is on the decision working people around the country will make in the next 50 days.
On November 3rd, voters will decide control of the House and Senate. They will decide whether this dangerous administration will spend its final two years with a check on their power, or whether things could get worse. And I have to tell you that I am concerned by how some in our party are talking about this fight.
There is a narrative taking hold in Washington that the Republicans are already cooked. Yes, the president’s approval rating collapsed. Yes, his agenda is unpopular. Some believe foolishly that the midterms will take care of themselves. I’ve heard that from elected officials, pundits, and operatives. We’ve seen that overconfidence on display in the media.
**That kind of complacency is how we grasp defeat from the jaws of victory.** What happened in the last few days alone should put an end to any cockiness.
* **On Sept 4:** Elon Musk announced that he’ll spend a small amount of his near $1 trillion fortune on Republicans _all over the country._
* **Sept 8:** Donald Trump finally authorized his “MAGA Inc” personal super PAC to unleash its more than $400 _million_ in cash to elect Republicans.

They’ve been holding onto this cash until the last minute, because they know most voters make their decisions very close to election day.
One man and one corrupt president now will flood every competitive race in America with cash. This is what the concentration of wealth and power looks like in an oligarchy. A television ad in a place like Montana to decide control of the House of Representatives, paid for by men who do not care what happens to working families across America.
Now, everything I am seeing on the ground in races all across the country tells me this could be a major midterm wave for Democrats. But let me be more precise:_it could be a wave if we work for it._ Musk and Trump do not spend this kind of money on races they believe are lost. They spend because they know they can win and hold the House and Senate. They spend because they believe Democrats might spend the next eight weeks patting ourselves on the back instead of organizing.
All of this is why I am not spending this fall thinking about myself. I am spending it working my butt off to deliver a majority in the House and the Senate.
Across this country, I have endorsed candidates I believe in. Sam Forstag, a former smokejumper and union organizer, running for an open House seat in Montana that Republicans are counting on. Abdul El-Sayed who won his Senate primary in Michigan against roughly $70 million in spending (and control of the Senate may well run through his race!). Angie Nixon, a state representative from Jacksonville, taking on a sitting Republican senator in Florida without a dime of corporate PAC money.
My entire campaign is mobilizing resources, not just to get me re-elected or build for a future campaign, but most importantly to win the midterms and take back the majority so we can make progress on issues like Medicare for All, universal childcare, a living wage, and more.
I don’t take corporate money. I don’t dial for dollars. Never have. So every dollar we put into this fight comes from people like YOU who decided it was worth it. Does that put us at a financial disadvantage compared to the billionaire class? Of course it does. It’s also the only way I’d ever do this work.
So I am asking you directly: Will you make a donation to our effort today that will help us get out the vote, win the midterms, and build for the future?
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20260914?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260914.6KN2q7&refcode=em20260914-12283-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=12283%2E2526796%2EY6GfiE)
The premise of this movement has always been that enough people giving what they can and standing together is more powerful than one or two wealthy men giving what they _want to control our future._
I didn’t get into this work for myself. I ran in 2018 because I believed my neighbors deserved representation that cared about them and the lives they lead. That’s why my focus is on the only decision that matters right now: the one voters will make in 50 days.
Pa'lante,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

subject: The most conservative forecaster shifted our way

body:
Inside Elections was the last major forecaster holding out on our race, and they just shifted their prediction of the Alaska Senate race in our direction.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/108394?refcode=em20260914-10899&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10899%2E614464%2E7sOPoB)
They’re joining every other major election forecaster in recognizing that the momentum is on our side. They know what we know: **We are going to win this race.**
Alaskans are ready for change. I’ve spent the past nine months traveling to communities in every corner of the state – from Prince of Wales to St. Lawrence Island, the Kenai to the Arctic. And everywhere I go, I hear the same thing: Enough.
Enough of Dan Sullivan’s self-dealing. He’s _tripled_ his personal wealth since getting to DC, and Alaskans are paying the price. We are getting crushed by corporate greed while he turns the other way, and we’re tired of it.
I’m angry that the millionaires and billionaires have rigged the system in DC against working Alaskans. I’m angry that it doesn’t work for us anymore. But I’m also optimistic. Alaskans are can-do people. And together, on November 3rd, we’re going to take the first step toward taking back our state.
We won nearly 50% of the vote in our open primary election last month, against 15 other candidates of all parties – including incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan.
More than 82,000 Alaskans cast their ballots in favor of our fish, family, freedom campaign for a more abundant Alaska. We beat the incumbent by more than 8 points, and in the first poll of the general election, we’re leading Dan Sullivan by 1 point in the final round of ranked choice voting.
Because while Alaskans are sending a clear message that we’re done with the self-dealing politics of the past, we’re going up against the entire DC establishment and their billionaire-backed super PACs – and they are pummeling us with attack ads. They’re noticing the momentum that we’re building in Alaska, and they’re spending BIG to stop us.
That’s why this race is so close. It’s the closest race in the country, a true 50/50 toss-up! And while I feel confident that, in the end, we are going to win, it isn’t going to be an easy fight. We are up against a corrupt DC system, and they’re fighting with everything they have to keep it that way.
**[With that in mind, please split a donation between Heartland Patriots and my campaign for U.S. Senate today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/108394?refcode=em20260914-10899&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10899%2E614464%2E7sOPoB)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/108394?refcode=em20260914-10899&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10899%2E614464%2E7sOPoB)**
I’m proud to be running a grassroots campaign. But it means that each and every one of us has to chip in what we can, when we can, to help us win this all-important race. For Alaska, and for the whole country.
Thank you for your support. It makes all the difference.
\- Mary

| Friend,
A critical bipartisan housing bill was poised to be signed into law by the president. A signing ceremony was scheduled to take place in the Capitol rotunda. The podium and stage were set up and the cameras were in position.
But at the last second, Donald Trump took to Truth Social and announced the signing ceremony was canceled, and issued an ultimatum to Congress: Pass the most restrictive voting legislation in American history or the housing bill is dead:

Trump is now taking the American economy hostage to try and rig the upcoming midterms.
Although not perfect, the bill is a major step in the right direction towards solving America’s housing and affordability crisis. The bill heavily restricts large institutional investors from buying up single-family homes, boosts housing stock, expands rural housing grants, and modernizes mortgage financing.
The SAVE Act on the other hand, is the most sweeping voter suppression law in American history. It would disenfranchise millions of voters, disproportionately Black and minority voters. In some states, it could end mail-in voting. It would also open the door to intimidating election workers with threats of prosecution. It is so extreme, that even some GOP Senators are refusing to support it.
In an attempt to persuade those GOP holdouts to support the SAVE Act, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller went to social media and just flat out admitted the true purpose of the bill like some cartoon villain revealing his master plan:

## Trump on AI Race: 'Whoever Wins AI Wins'
President Trump [waved off](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE8DHch_C3bhIg3dpk2J3toPeInByPaCuH1ErpDuk0YazTdfz_EJFGibP2FFW6Y4bnjmgKVgGoESOMxLou2HtnnF5N7pgs2PgomuYabhagRX6MBRQe3thChQ1mh5r43UTBhWL1aLTvcvePV8ksr3Zno4rx_IGHo0DkRN9u5jhivOmFK6NZ5JpnrDuZJaaVkphp5KTO13pK0sOIUrHphaF9c62KWUPVfyoxJDJYbzPNsLlhjvtBLDLVSJYY-BCrkbIRVyAW8s6b3uTYYrNwemq9lwhtunmWJymBuuhFay46pdyhrqZP1-UgiUu75SbF6Bwt-I8s_vDit-AwAA__8cYIRG) the week's AI doomsday warnings Sunday at his golf course in Ireland: _"We're leading China in AI. ## Russian Drones Force Boris Johnson Off Train
A Russian drone [struck a Ukrainian train](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAUhZ8GNtD1TwEPHrqwpWtHdGNfwm2MHdlOUN6-oq_Q9TvS0Tnf92W5IAeOty_cydY1LZGOEqhWygtyRkdlyxzvHG87ZffMb4x-kSCHDkwn9IKu8osWja23K5Ek1ZIV42TUBNJAu1ntgK6TkmDkuK5-RDBqMORWD6O44tqyPfvACC0AtJ5640GBHo0QWk16Uo0G8lxT7n8Sx7rRGt7pRbl3aW-D3Wp9lEZ9NnJu5HwcR__GLaUzbeR8HjpxysE3csZc2QU6UX6WwtiVmp_u3tWMHLtImLtHChh9JwYYhdLTR7_VPbTZ-sfBIXAZxkbDbUcOfwvqP8W9rPwNAAD__12QguA) about a mile from the Polish border Sunday, shortly after former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through on another train. The drone hit the train's engine 15 minutes after its passengers were evacuated. No one was hurt, and Ukraine's railway said the "diplomatic train" was quite possibly the real target. The officials, heading home from a security conference in Kyiv, included [a top adviser](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyhCAYBOCnwe6cnx9OoaBIQ3dpUzoIv0qCeIOczr19xrxC6p3Zb3a_HsPDxRTz_OlWMnXahkznnqhWKoOLxXnalxLzT8zzSsW_ytvlMCBgdwN943JwvsaDBumaYCYiJNGQ4b3SQgFqaBYzjZ1XXcDO9-NIdyXDqJyaHHrPUSrfRHP1geaSA0ipWh1AgOw151IoqQSTQCHWrbTfW8x1oSm9t4NK67e1SWap9bkz8cHQMrTnebbP4o7grrh9OYaW8szQXtMY2gtjaEEztFwwtAruAhEY2qaY8DxjSnHveiZhXl1Mf0r95zmHwd8AAAD__x6bdSc) to German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Former CIA Director David Petraeus was on a third train nearby. _"I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive,"_ Johnson wrote, urging allies to send Ukraine "the air defences they need."
## Governor Candidate Swims From Sinking Plane
Tom Tiffany, Wisconsin's Republican candidate for governor, [swam to safety](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u4yAQxJ_G7rAAE38UFNe4y7VXWhtY7L3gJQISK29_8r3CvxvNTxrNzJ_7egeKxNtvONDWkFbGs0SsFfMKlMFh2TPxk3g7MLt3_gL7VUs9CDkLZVZwlT64Gmi9DYga-xatGqe5n6SeZbvbSQ04P7xCE5SW4-BnZZQz4G8Ogpa3luyVJy9bSmOmbvayl2aclTL9ZKa-MRI91ZS7v4m47hjiN30wdy4dbbR7ra_S9L8avTR6Oc-zc49y7bh4o5dLXoCKS1yIhUu8ZSzlABY1HaJSCMBfEeGJ4oR3gbd4RWAULkPZRQT2xFujlzZb_zopRirD2Bi5HUDxf436w_c-Vv8LAAD__57Chnk) after the plane carrying him home from a campaign dinner lost power and ditched in Lake Wausau. The pilot reported engine trouble on approach to Wausau Downtown Airport around 8:50 p.m. CT Saturday, the FAA said. The [four-seat Beechcraft Bonanza](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2S3CAQhJ8GZbOFEHdCgQInZOfUoWoWBu34-FEBu1t6e5fsR3Dc1V91f7--ti_kyHn_iYnWHsqW6d0i9U51Q67oqD0q52_Oe6LqnvXE7Dcl1SfIBUa9oev8ok3j4NdApGgaaB1ns0xGqkUOj1V-TBI__GyCuhtndJiDv3tNd1TeLLMbeL14chn1KKXW5rZ4OUk9L-OoJ6PNJLQkz73U2-_CuT8oxLO8qN5cSUNcH70fTUw_hLJC2XwepfUrEspeYKGsXISy4ySUfTa4Hgple0nQOQTMJ7y5uZIbZ9jLAfvFzqWCw-zZYydob04NQi0J2j8bcETMBBg6VaBEdafsToj4TRCvXt6FskNd_fHmGLl9zkLLPSHHv7P7f9p-repPAAAA__9JfJZf) began sinking, and the two swam to shallow water to wait for rescuers. Both were released from the hospital, Tiffany with stitches above his right eye. _"God was watching over us tonight,"_ [he wrote](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6jAQgOHTOB1oPJ7EceHiNZFewVZIlNEoGRPvOg5yDCy3X7FX2PYvvuK_nMYTxxTz9YNX8TVsY5bnnqRWKSPHwpPsS4n5K-brKmW6lxfneUTA7gDuoGnkqcaHjMTN7IMIimnEa9s70wM6aBavW0ZCq0PQhshy6yz3LqBhF6Rz0kT_9sBp0gBE_dHNYICs05pMT71RBDLHupXj5xZzXSSk1_aQcpy2tUl-qfW2K_NP4aBw-H5XhcN5W88xBM6vy3-Fw1653neFA4JzAGBbRy30xlLbNcXPt2dMKe6dVQTXlWP6xesfnzw8_gQAAP__b7FyNw). Fellow Conservative: In 1991, the mob came for Clarence Thomas. They smeared him. They tried to destroy his name, his reputation, and his honor. As Justice Thomas himself has put it, critics in Washington _"don't bomb you, necessarily, but they bomb your reputation or your good name or your honor."_ **He refused to cave.** And because he did, he became one of the four giants of the modern Supreme Court — alongside Justices Scalia, Alito, and Rehnquist. Senator Ted Cruz has just released a remarkable new book: _**Going Further: The Incomparable Clarence Thomas**_ , built on exclusive interviews with the Justice himself.

---
|
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=42a92230bd1b4452898a61338f041291&_e=sUngcObTAwHHCe5ZcFiEButI5Xxw_plLaqA-s3egaTZhVXwEFGnRfprfrAY6ogX-l27ZQaXvHjnRuUj_n7C6tSwYfFACmUtDXcUVg9kDiv0J7tIOuE3Eh_ekGBuwYI35_RBGijsRdkOvbVHlIJ-iq8JSGhU9XGGfmxGOnNWJwAa4eeQo5rbYucxBBD8CntH4woz28_eyKcP7wFIrMI9r622p5LPmqHY9OZgR6cZF41li28CV0w5x9499evbcU-7h0r54bvXkpJCdmOrHVx9l-OvzecpTBB8KWL2slMOP2zZruO47-zGd04Nx5ld8ryz88-k4rq5-6csm-wCNoZs_NFOVWYsD7chh9B8c4tWtQuxvTkp7XTdZkFZM-LEZqZTphWllwavucp_Nv3AvZmRplw%3D%3D)
---
|

There's a moment in the book that says everything. When Justice Scalia told Thomas he was _"tilting at windmills"_ by trying to overturn bad precedent, Thomas shot back: _"Nino, windmills are dangerous."_

That is the kind of courage we need on the federal bench. And here is the part every conservative must understand:

**Clarence Thomas only reached the Supreme Court because the Senate confirmed him by just two votes.**

Presidents nominate judges. But the Senate confirms them. Every originalist on the bench, and every one we hope to see there, depends on having conservative senators willing to fight. When we lose the Senate, we lose the courts. It's that simple.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: In for a long race
body:
I can tell we’re getting to them.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1328&source=&t=1&akid=3487%2E124072%2EIEi6NL) | | | |

Peter, when the Vice President came to North Carolina to attack me by name, **I knew we were in for a long race.**
When President Trump’s attack dog Stephen Miller went on Fox News to rant and rave about me, **I knew they were nervous.**
Now, after President Trump used the GOP's largest stage to attack me with baseless lies, **I can tell we’re getting to them.**
There are a lot of important Senate races happening this year, but President Trump knows that if they just win in NC, it’ll stop our chances of taking back the Senate. It won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If our MAGA opponent – former Big Oil and utility lobbyist Michael Whatley – wins here, that’s the ballgame. Republicans will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
That’s why we’re facing these nonstop attacks, and why I’m emailing you today. We’re facing our mid-month deadline tomorrow night, and we’re behind our goal. If we miss this goal, it’ll make it much harder to run the ads we need to win – and this is a race we just can’t afford to lose.
[**_So please, will you chip in whatever you can to help us hit our $2.5 million mid-month goal before the deadline on Tuesday so we can fight back against the GOP and win in NC?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1328&amount=5&t=8&akid=3487%2E124072%2EIEi6NL)

## Triple-Digit Heat Holds through Midweek
Texas is set to start the workweek back under heat advisories, with Monday highs near or above 100 degrees and humidity pushing feels-like readings [as high as 110](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb_G7ogAMyYuKLZJN9tuab3AIzyFQAQvcfz3K88vTHt1dXR0_n2v30CZyu0vPNDxJ9a14NYzMmNbfd2ude9QAuMHSr-Tv9cYMa9a6lnIRSizgmd642pgDO4qw6JGdMqel-k8WTONyfk4z3Y6ewM4X-0iUfpF2gDRqmv01o7kDpxclFFKavV1sl4rtADmS58johmMxEBc24kTHio95r2-sZ18fYzZJeZnH6Y_g74M-rJt2ynWj4VXZyrH5RgROGEb9MVj4QZZ_HBEBI9ddHgVEJnuKNLrQYF4F9zomVEEuhGLRLfUxasEbCIhsIDwpl7bPjYXnhvlTH22g5G3B1D-0eLf5nw7_T8AAP__QTSPZQ) across much of the eastern half of the state. A dome of high pressure has North Texas locked in for [at least another 72 hours](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGyoyAYhZ9GOxxAolhQbJMu227pIByUCYEMsGre_o55hdv-881_vnP-PeaH9sHH9a9-QdXTpTniKAG1Is8mHUv6FB1txaljeXrzTM4hzJzygdCJMDFrU_2OWejWqoXaibVQbJRTL_tR9O2m5LCMclicBRwGMxiGwXB6swsXk5RT69X1jk5MMEY5u3Wj4Qyj1uLGpQNEIyisryl3dcOlUlz4pB25M-nVBrXV-i5N_6fh94bfj-PoXDrFVeQCrhN03ZAbft-gK9F29yVlj0JwVkQLS7TJqRQSU64b-WaQL-ujxUl2Hf6jkAidfVwJo5JYrBkobVb2ffgQfBnGRtD1pX34etXf7rkr_hMAAP__pfqPJQ). Morning lows at DFW airport will hover near 80, and south-southwest winds of 10 to 20 mph will act more like a blow dryer than relief. Along the Gulf Coast, sea breezes and afternoon heating are projected to keep firing [spotty storms that die off by sunset](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb8Gd4zgmRnsgiKNu02b0nqG5wUNAytgzDpfHznKH6S9Orr36P76WD8wxJA-f-KLTPve85qo10itUVlt7ls-KybX6BtTfQb7zPtOcQUBDy5mLtWKtoWDVoWDM5twsxzISD3N4zRqNQ7eCKJRS9R2U05IAaPV-Njm-wSoLc5yCOaqE7NUUgqQ95u2IEkjqjtMO5FiSpALLZdb83Sp1D2e-aBys_k1RONb-6ps_MFgYbD03m82BvsEn9-15XRRV07YPBUGyzXHYBEzg0WODJZ_IH8nR4Uj94SNoztCzeXk9Z0cnryH5jly6zFZ4nsuvBLyrRD9Jl597lQqg2Uoxn31EGOoD82U-HxhiH9F2_8efBj4EwAA__-tfZHs). Some neighborhoods should pick up a quick downpour while others stay dry. Feels-like numbers are expected to climb toward 110. Relief is expected late in the week, when the heat dome should shift east, and highs settle back into the upper 90s. Austin has already logged 44 triple-digit days this year, including [39 of the 43 days since Aug. 1](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ8Gu2sAGZWCYhu72XZLc4WLkmFgIozOvP3GbfYB_u6cnOTLl_PnPt8xxJDW3_gkUz8-z4nOEqlW2mebzyV_CyZX6YOpPIJ9ZO8pzpLLHrgGoWa0NRw0K2ycWbjToiEjhlF3YzeortmMEFp48nb0jix3TiN3upd20b28KaebYC4c10IJwaW4tYOVggZEdZOjJ1JMcXKh5r2tG10qxcdvPmhvbX420Wy1vgrrfjE5MTmd59k-Ppiu8aqEdaP9f4Il5pXJ6QKA5pA9OPwW2PAgWIgSCM4hJMB3qSFBCckS4HsFweTU7Ma9zhBjKP3AFF-fGOI_j_rT_w4j_wYAAP__eYeGbQ).
## Family Sues Fort Worth Daycare
A Fort Worth couple is [suing their son's daycare](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOozAQxvGnMd1EtjFLKCiuodtrr0TDeAxWHBzZk2R5-xN5ha1H-uk_37_v-Rtjivv6F-88yk_I887vmliEy0z5veSj4u6Ff3Cvt0i3HAKn2Wr7BXoA42YkiS-eHTZ-XLQfTMOj6a9De2171zbb6DCwc21HwzIw9jh401Lf6e5KuDBhE8eT04NxxmhruktP1nCP6Dp7DcxOOc0-Si4X2fhMqSEd-cXlQvnepHETeVTV_lF2Unbaj0eucp6UnU5Z2UkPyk7GKjs9K5wfKjt9IPB4EBYGJHpW9pADlOe-x30F2mLyEOK6CVB6LoBBuIAw0sYFMCVe2acDUATpxh4cHIwFcvLKTk0Z_eMdU4r1q1dOr3eM6VMsv136Ndr_AQAA__9dF5V6), alleging a teacher grabbed, shook, and dragged a 4-year-old before slamming him onto a hardwood floor. Heather and Richard Harris [filed suit Sept. 4](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2upDoMgJ8GOo-CCRAKitvQndtuiUziQHQyZEQ8w-HtV1lpn2Bb_36f_etr-aIQw7H9T0-e5Men5eArRxbhc7HpWtOd6XDCP3Tk72C_k_ccF1TYgxqh0QtZCR9eNNVuWpUbm5qnZjBja9pBt_U-MTadaxW1OPad7bXRrtWuR2PQIDHVYSrj1NjoplHYdI_BYsMDke7QeGZdacUuSDofsnNByT7e6cPnw6ZnHadd5JWr9r8K5wrn67oelycqyQpnOiXYyBXOxazCORwfzhI2kpCOEvD0DPGG_OYMPp0CVzplB0e3pZOhLAKKkTd2YPcQHfiw7QI2vleIdN18QqY7g-wk8HpLLuV_-zOkA44kwRYGNAMgkllHr2HoDINWToOxykPn1pV6LKfh-pzc6woxhtwPlVbbk0L8oyv_-qbPhL8DAAD__1cwqdk) in Tarrant County against Arka Montessori Academy of Risinger. They claim teacher Chynia Johnson steered the boy back toward her own son, who had been scuffling with him, while a second teacher stood by. "_This place looked like a child fight club. It felt like one_ ," family attorney Russell Button said of the [surveillance video](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHO2yAUxfGnwRsRYBLwwNDF29e1o3UNFxsFmwhu4vjtK_cVOh_pr5_On5_pB1JO-_IbNnT0jWXa8WgZibBOvhxzORvsgfALe3sm_ywxYp6UUA8uBi71BJ7SBycNXXCzCIPs0Eljh972Rvfd6oSV1tgZjInG9j5KBCvw3nspjHj0qkvuyolBaimFkveb8UqiAdB3ZSOiZlpgSFTqjVa8KC3ms3yw3nzZuuxWoldj_S-mRqbGtZSQ047XyNR4tZkaxcDUGEslfpRKK4-wpXzy9sbGA5weKvIGZ-ONIEasHJcFAy87pxJCxspjWlbiPr9npsauuvA6Us6pPQzTYtkg5X8c-t8bP079DQAA__8F7Iii). The suit says the boy suffered bruises, scratches, and headaches, and has since stopped attending the daycare. State regulators cited the center for improper discipline and prohibited punishment after the April 27 incident. Records show 21 deficiencies since January 2024, though an Aug. 20 inspection found none. The daycare declined to comment.

Last week, Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned with a warning that there was a >10% chance of AI destroying humanity by the end of the decade. That is, within the next 4 years.
It took over the news for days.
A variety of researchers and industry figures have made similar warnings over the past months. There were recent reports of bots breaking free of their sandbox and hacking organizations, and of governments trying to weaponize Anthropic's Claude to harm American interests. But Jacob's words, perhaps because he was leaving Anthropic weeks before its IPO, set off a firestorm. His post has received 166 million impressions and counting, and Jacob has been doing major news interviews ever since.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16bef190-a9ae-4345-be34-661eeae3c9cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As someone who has been talking about AI in public life since 2018, my phone has been ringing off the hook. A number of figures, including members of Congress, reached out to me for advice. I went on MSNOW, CNN, Fox, NewsNation, and other outlets to talk about what sensible guardrails would look like.
On Saturday, Dario Amodei called for an industry slowdown, asserting that bots could cause hundreds of billions of dollars worth of damage and take over the Internet. Sam Altman and Elon Musk quickly concurred. This is encouraging stuff, but cementing a slowdown almost certainly requires regulation and policy, not self-policing on the part of the AI companies.
The most fundamental ask for the AI companies is a killswitch. Right now, if you go to OpenAI and ask it the basic question, "Okay, if your bots go haywire, how do you turn them off?" they don't have any kind of response. Think about that for a moment. You spend hundreds of billions of dollars on AI and there isn't a leash. One thing I love about the killswitch requirement is that it would require them to have a much more buttoned-up approach to their models where they couldn't just release them into the wild. There is a bipartisan killswitch [bill](https://substack.com/redirect/07d2b36e-7dff-45c5-bc60-01c8ed973dd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the docket right now that could be passed tomorrow if Congress got its act together.
Another move would be to hold the AI companies accountable for damages incurred by bad actors using their models; if they were susceptible to this kind of liability, it would dramatically change their caution levels.
A third safeguard would be that models can't be released into broad use until after they go through an inspection period.
The truth is that the incentives are leading us to disaster; let's say you're at Anthropic. You have a trillion-dollar IPO on tap with everyone around you set to profit handsomely and are competing against OpenAI as well as Google, Meta, xAI and Chinese firms. It's pedal to the metal all the time. If you raise your hand and say, "Hey guys, how about we slow down and make sure this model won't get beyond our control" one of your competitors will race ahead. The people around you will probably ignore you and sideline you, maybe demote or fire you. So you cross your fingers and hope for the best.
Asking these AI companies to resist this dynamic is futile. Jacob Coxon pretty much said as much when he resigned.
Congress can do what most Americans are begging them to do and install safeguards and get us off the fast track to catastrophe. Sure, some dimwits will yell at them and say, "You're going to give China a chance to jump into the lead!" The proper response is, "I'm confident that American tech firms can do two things at once: continue to break new ground in AI and also keep us from Skynet killing us all or hacking the grid and sending us into the stone age." I even believe that trying to get Chinese firms to agree to some guardrails would be the right thing to do, while accepting that we're not confident that they would actually do so. This is a humanity-scale challenge.
I don't wake up every morning saying, "I wish I was President!" I don't live life that way. But when I see the absolute lack of leadership in DC stepping up to put us on a safer path, it makes me wish that I was in position to temper the breakneck pace of AI development. I'd do a much better job than what we are getting. I hope that we heed Jacob's warning. We are running out of time.
Feel free to reach out to your [member](https://substack.com/redirect/b41d760a-8055-41fb-a646-c5def4eb0003?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Congress and tell them to act on AI safeguards. I talk to Zach this week about the Jacob Coxon warning and more on [http://andrewyang.com/podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/39c88a54-8170-48fd-a464-9823ed074de8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). clean_body: Last week, Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned with a warning that there was a >10% chance of AI destroying humanity by the end of the decade. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | ---|---|--- * | | | Sep 14 | | | | | | | | | | | | Last week, Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon publicly resigned with a warning that there was a >10% chance of AI destroying humanity by the end of the decade. That is, within the next 4 years. It took over the news for days. A variety of researchers and industry figures have made similar warnings over the past months. There were recent reports of bots breaking free of their sandbox and hacking organizations, and of governments trying to weaponize Anthropic's Claude to harm American interests. But Jacob's words, perhaps because he was leaving Anthropic weeks before its IPO, set off a firestorm. His post has received 166 million impressions and counting, and Jacob has been doing major news interviews ever since. | | ---|---|--- As someone who has been talking about AI in public life since 2018, my phone has been ringing off the hook. A number of figures, including members of Congress, reached out to me for advice. I went on MSNOW, CNN, Fox, NewsNation, and other outlets to talk about what sensible guardrails would look like. On Saturday, Dario Amodei called for an industry slowdown, asserting that bots could cause hundreds of billions of dollars worth of damage and take over the Internet. Sam Altman and Elon Musk quickly concurred. This is encouraging stuff, but cementing a slowdown almost certainly requires regulation and policy, not self-policing on the part of the AI companies. The most fundamental ask for the AI companies is a killswitch. Right now, if you go to OpenAI and ask it the basic question, "Okay, if your bots go haywire, how do you turn them off?" they don't have any kind of response. Think about that for a moment. You spend hundreds of billions of dollars on AI and there isn't a leash. One thing I love about the killswitch requirement is that it would require them to have a much more buttoned-up approach to their models where they couldn't just release them into the wild. There is a bipartisan killswitch on the docket right now that could be passed tomorrow if Congress got its act together. Another move would be to hold the AI companies accountable for damages incurred by bad actors using their models; if they were susceptible to this kind of liability, it would dramatically change their caution levels. A third safeguard would be that models can't be released into broad use until after they go through an inspection period. The truth is that the incentives are leading us to disaster; let's say you're at Anthropic. You have a trillion-dollar IPO on tap with everyone around you set to profit handsomely and are competing against OpenAI as well as Google, Meta, xAI and Chinese firms. It's pedal to the metal all the time. If you raise your hand and say, "Hey guys, how about we slow down and make sure this model won't get beyond our control" one of your competitors will race ahead. The people around you will probably ignore you and sideline you, maybe demote or fire you. So you cross your fingers and hope for the best. Asking these AI companies to resist this dynamic is futile. Jacob Coxon pretty much said as much when he resigned. Congress can do what most Americans are begging them to do and install safeguards and get us off the fast track to catastrophe. Sure, some dimwits will yell at them and say, "You're going to give China a chance to jump into the lead!" The proper response is, "I'm confident that American tech firms can do two things at once: continue to break new ground in AI and also keep us from Skynet killing us all or hacking the grid and sending us into the stone age." I even believe that trying to get Chinese firms to agree to some guardrails would be the right thing to do, while accepting that we're not confident that they would actually do so. This is a humanity-scale challenge. I don't wake up every morning saying, "I wish I was President!" I don't live life that way. But when I see the absolute lack of leadership in DC stepping up to put us on a safer path, it makes me wish that I was in position to temper the breakneck pace of AI development. I'd do a much better job than what we are getting. I hope that we heed Jacob's warning. We are running out of time. Feel free to reach out to your of Congress and tell them to act on AI safeguards. body:
Here’s what I’ve been up to!

| Peter, I hope this will be a breath of fresh air compared to the endless emails offering you fake matches and phony memberships.
My least favorite part of campaigning is fundraising, so instead, I wanted to share these 6 photos with you!
It’s been a while... so here’s what I’ve been up to on the campaign trail:

[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/9TmCAW3ApNfSzrIP1DBahQ)
---
I learned all about fly fishing and even made my own fly with the Virginia Coastal Fly Anglers at their Annual Fly Fishing Expo! I’m grateful to have learned so much from a great group of passionate outdoorsmen.
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/tP5Di76sem55tobcQ1zTRQ)

I joined our volunteers for a “Team Kiggans’ Day of Action” – I’m so grateful for our volunteers working so hard!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/crPfU3MWhsfocXc9ATOeGw)
---
I had a lot of fun catching up with people at the Isle of Wight Hunt Club Annual Shrimp Feast!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/aTSxKOTkp6y2rfUQeqEJww)
---
It was a blessing to join the welcoming congregation at Big House Church with Pastor Ruckel. Keep praying...!!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/0UAY4wauxFkEga4q6F4Zhg)
---
I had a blast serving shrimp and fish with the Shriners at the Khedive Shrine Center in Chesapeake for their Seafood Fest!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/1dE4M28CBKGAYJBZjdxW3Q)
---
I had a great day on Tangier Island on the Eastern Shore! It’s a hidden gem of VA-02, and I appreciated chatting with local residents about how I can help solve challenges facing the island.**
**★★★**
**My favorite part of my job is meeting people in the community, hearing their stories, and taking their stories to Washington, DC to deliver real results... not many career politicians would say the same!**
**As I promised earlier, I only wanted to share these photos and exciting updates with you from the campaign trail.
Thank you for reading this email all the way through, it means the world to me. [If you would like to give a donation to support our campaign in the final 60 days before Election Day, I would be so grateful to see your donation come across my desk.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwOTE0X0g0LVBPLjExMDExN190MjAyMDAxOS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDkxNF9INC1QTy4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjAwMTktMjA2OCJ9/MFNXIsuM_YUtj32iUKtg6w)

**Jen Kiggans Congresswoman, VA-02

Dear Fellow American,

I hope you're having a good day. I'm writing with some exciting news.
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc2unSwYha8GZxoE_Bs4-L6ozWl6dtM66JAgvOibIBDBfW6_Ock-N9DpepJnJWv9eZfvCh36_aFOGDElaYKR-YALnMoYfDowbpA_APwejGSUtSUdylpIpTM-QQpVmLFhdW_7Asa66wfed6LpimNsB9ZtujVWW9W3vIO6oQ0T9aaU0GrjBY6fPjrUomZU1G1VK6t5Y0E0DVDabkTQOxqVoUKf0EDSIcQYHGbUqQrXXrjxyDkmwv8jbCFsQW9DdaBzySgHFZibsKXcwUPCVNoLoDRPUwZr4SJ8SZrwidJBtA_KBPvx_f_p5zTPK2HtnU-Zwn1pIHyKV0gRdEa_v9AJBu-T8AlOhe4VanVGhbsnfHpVSvM0XzD4DD4TPn2bH_P6ti6_51n-6sq3dS2_hiiu0cQPdA5T2xFB9097pcNZ5H-95zmyvwEAAP__VsWgcA)
Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**To receive your FREE Genesis DVD box set, please use the secure link here:**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/-genesis-free-dvd-offer](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc2unSwYha8GZxoE_Bs4-L6ozWl6dtM66JAgvOibIBDBfW6_Ock-N9DpepJnJWv9eZfvCh36_aFOGDElaYKR-YALnMoYfDowbpA_APwejGSUtSUdylpIpTM-QQpVmLFhdW_7Asa66wfed6LpimNsB9ZtujVWW9W3vIO6oQ0T9aaU0GrjBY6fPjrUomZU1G1VK6t5Y0E0DVDabkTQOxqVoUKf0EDSIcQYHGbUqQrXXrjxyDkmwv8jbCFsQW9DdaBzySgHFZibsKXcwUPCVNoLoDRPUwZr4SJ8SZrwidJBtA_KBPvx_f_p5zTPK2HtnU-Zwn1pIHyKV0gRdEa_v9AJBu-T8AlOhe4VanVGhbsnfHpVSvM0XzD4DD4TPn2bH_P6ti6_51n-6sq3dS2_hiiu0cQPdA5T2xFB9097pcNZ5H-95zmyvwEAAP__VsWgcA)

Time and time again, Republicans have won the presidency despite LOSING the popular vote.

---|---|---
The ad stars "Debby from Hernando," a woman presented to viewers as a lifelong Mississippi Republican who has soured on Hyde-Smith. Debby is actually Debby Quigley, a transplant from Houston, Texas, who only recently moved to Mississippi.
In the ad, Debby says:
> _" I'm Debby and I live in Hernando. I have voted Republican in the past and I feel pretty betrayed these days. Everything costs more and Cindy Hyde-Smith is just oblivious to it. She cares more about her billionaire donors than the people of this state."_

Debby's Facebook page is littered with "86-47" posts. On April 28, 2026, the same day a federal grand jury [indicted former FBI Director James Comey](https://substack.com/redirect/0572e5b6-0218-4326-adad-bb09eb2b5822?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for threatening to harm President Trump with his own "86 47" post, Debby shared a graphic reading, "I wonder if we all posted 8647 if we would all be indicted?" She captioned it "8647 #8647." The post she shared came from a Facebook group called "Democrats Defending Democracy: We Won't Back Down," where the original poster wrote, "FU DONNIE CAPONE YOU MOTHER F***ING POS!!"
In another post from May 16, 2025, Debby wrote "8647\. He is a liar." alongside a string of angry-face emojis.

When you visit American Bridge's website, the super PAC maintains a page literally titled "targets" that lists elected Senate Republicans and Republican candidates under photos of their faces, complete with a running list of attack pieces against each candidate.

| | | Friend, it's Mark Kelly, senator for Arizona and DSCC Vice Chair. Doesn't each year of Trump feel like a decade?

I'll explain what I mean in a moment, but first, let me save you some time: **[Will you chip in $7 to help us take back the Senate and place a check on Trump? >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/23346?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260914-MarkKelly-KellyRetrospectiveFR-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260914-MarkKelly-KellyRetrospectiveFR-ETG-sl1&akid=26027%2E9716520%2EuDk1wG)**

If I tried to write down all the bizarre things that have happened to our country in the past two years at the hands of Donald Trump, I would run out of ink.

**Chaotic tariffs. A war in Iran. DOGE. Dismantling the Corporation for Public Broadcasting. Pardoning January 6th attackers. ICE shootings. Attacking voting rights. Rolling back reproductive freedom. Musk. Epstein. Stephen Miller.**

Heck, Trump even called for my arrest and _hanging_ ‐‐ _because I reminded our troops of the law._

Everything I just listed merely scratches the surface of what we've had to endure these past two years. _It's exhausting._

**But in November, we have a chance to put a stop to that madness by taking back the Senate. If we accomplish that, we'll place an important check on Trump's actions, nominees, and agenda.**

That said, it won't be easy. We'll need to flip four seats blue to get it done, and Democrats are polling neck‐and‐neck in _multiple_ key states. And with Republicans spending hundreds of millions to keep the Senate in their hands, we'll need to work hard to counter their dark money.

But that hard work is nothing compared to the exhaustion of another two years of unchecked Trump power. We need to dig deep and give it our all _right now_ to prevent that.

As a DSCC Vice Chair, I can assure you we're putting in the work, but it just won't be possible to finish the mission unless we see a surge of grassroots support. **So, I'm asking for your help:**

name: Roy Cooper
subject: I wish there were another way
body:
If there were a way to win a U.S. Senate seat without ever asking for donations, I’d do it in a heartbeat.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1329&source=&t=1&akid=3505%2E124072%2EDbp6zY) | | | |
---
I don’t normally speak in superlatives, Peter, but there are two things that are impossible for me to overstate:
1) How desperate right-wing billionaires and corporate megadonors are to defeat us.
2) How much I dislike asking folks for their hard-earned money.
If there were a way to win a U.S. Senate seat without ever asking for donations, I’d do it in a heartbeat. But the fact that the GOP megadonor class can spend unlimited money – _and already is_ – to try to buy North Carolina for Trump’s hand-picked candidate makes it unrealistic.
[**_So if you get the problem and are willing to help us tackle it head-on, I hope you’ll consider chipping in today. We have until midnight tomorrow to reach our most ambitious mid-month goal yet of the entire campaign, and we still have a ways to go._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1329&amount=5&t=8&akid=3505%2E124072%2EDbp6zY)
The thing is, Big Money is why so much in Washington DC is broken nowadays. Too often, politicians opt to take the easy route: fall in line, accept massive checks – with strings attached – to win elections and then do as they’re told to keep the cash flowing. _All the while, the voices of the working people who voted them in continue to go unheard._
**North Carolinians don’t have to settle for that.**
Those at the top are terrified of what can happen when people understand their collective power to fundamentally change the system. What can happen when elections are no longer for sale.
Our people-powered campaign can overcome over $100 million in dark money and flip this seat blue for the first time since 2008. And it will be nothing short of a political earthquake.
So while I truly loathe asking you for money, I am going to because I know that transforming our politics by taking back North Carolina – and with it, the Senate majority – is worth it:
[**_Please Peter, will you contribute $5 or any amount you can spare to help us get the rest of the way to our $2.5 million goal? If we plan on winning this seat and fixing what’s broken in Washington DC, then we can’t afford to fall short tonight._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1329&amount=5&t=9&akid=3505%2E124072%2EDbp6zY)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1329&amount=5&t=10&akid=3505%2E124072%2EDbp6zY)

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

| Team, this is bad:

We’re pacing significantly behind our $43,000 September mid-month fundraising goal, and our deadline expires tomorrow at midnight. This is our _last quarter_ before the election. **Which means it’s our last chance to get the resources we need in the door before we go full throttle supporting must-win Senate races.**

I know you’re busy, and I apologize for disrupting your day, but flipping the Senate blue has to be our #1 priority. Must-win races in Texas, Ohio, and right here in New Hampshire are counting on our support.

_If we fall short of our $43,000 mid-month fundraising we may have to cut back on our efforts to help flip the Senate. If we do that, we’d be giving the GOP an opening to put even more ads and pummel key battleground races with millions of dollars hoping to buy the midterms._

We know that Republicans are paying attention to Democratic grassroots support, hoping to see a lull in our momentum. We can’t give them that edge. So, I’m doing something a little different.

Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed **[snapped at CBS's Weijia Jiang](https://substack.com/redirect/d46c16f9-21d6-4b67-8df1-918b4dd52693?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for asking him about his past ties to Hasan Piker, saying voters care about grocery prices, healthcare access, and environmental concerns -- not "Twitch streamers in California."

subject: Consider this my cover letter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Peter, I've had a lot of jobs. My work life started when I was nine years old, and I started mowing our lawn every weekend. At 14, I started waiting tables at the local drugstore diner. Since then, I've cleaned houses, picked fruit, tested water quality for local businesses, and even deciphered doctors' chicken scratch in a hospital billing department.**For my family and me, hard work was the _only_ way to get ahead.**

I know just how hard Iowans work to make a living. The people of our district deserve more than a representative like Mariannette Miller-Meeks, who does the bare minimum _(not even that sometimes!)._

**In every job I've had, I gave 110%, and I intend to do the same in Congress.**

Peter, at the end of the day, being a representative is a job, and I'm running to go above and beyond for you and the issues you care about. Will you give me the opportunity to fight for a better future for our district? **[Chip in to our $15,000 mid-month goal to strengthen my campaign ahead of the election in November>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139167244/646461154/-2016015222?refcode=em26_260914_MM2_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260914_MM2_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=7137c0ca-48b0-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTM3YzBjYS00OGIwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V92bwv58tOyH-VX4h_SHFNH6NQq7SUlHvBWGIS6I8j0=)**

| As you’ll see, the ad highlights my success in my first term in promoting transparency and accountability in government spending, particularly by putting the state checkbook online so you can see exactly where your hard-earned tax dollars are going. It’s a message I’m confident will resonate with voters in this election.

I also want to give you an important update on where this campaign stands. Critically, we’ve reached a milestone in that we’ve raised and banked enough money to cover our basic overhead costs from here on out. That means __every single dollar we raise the rest of the way will go directly into my voter-contact effort.__

If you [contribute today](https://us.list-manage.com/l1vfdr31eWe?e=6736d7bc47&c2id=6d83a76682c29c59feb3e3d11de85f73) — and I hope you will — your contribution will go _directly_ toward putting that ad in front of the voters we need to reach in the closing weeks of this race.

[You can contribute by clicking here](https://us.list-manage.com/Soh3G0dY__P?e=6736d7bc47&c2id=6d83a76682c29c59feb3e3d11de85f73), or, if you prefer, you can contribute by check made out to “Andy For Nevada” and mailed to:

Andy For Nevada
P.O. Box 35666
Las Vegas, NV 89133

My team calculates we need to raise another $50,000 to fully execute our voter-contact plan. And I hope you can help me reach that goal. If you can, please [pitch in today](https://us.list-manage.com/TkLZVBy74C6?e=6736d7bc47&c2id=6d83a76682c29c59feb3e3d11de85f73) to help ensure we have the resources we know it will take to get my message out to the voters who most need to hear it.

By the way, I want you to know that my team and I are going to be _very strategic_ in how we use the funds that you and other patriotic Nevadans are so generously giving to my campaign.

We have the ability, thanks to the most modern technology, to identify the voters who are going to make the difference in this race — independents as well as both Republicans and Democrats who tend to be “swing” voters — and put my message _directly in front of them_. And that’s just what we’re going to do.

It’s a hyper-precise way of making sure that every dollar we spend on voter-contact and persuasion is targeted as efficiently and effectively as possible. After all, you deserve nothing less for your investment in my campaign. I’m as committed to being accountable and transparent with the money you donate to my campaign as I am in handling your tax dollars that fund government!

Thank you, my friend, for taking the time to read this email, and for your generous support for my efforts to fight for our shared values. I hope I can count on you again!

For Nevada’s future,

Andy

My granddaughter crawls across the kitchen floor. She stands. She steps. She toddles. Down she goes, and she crawls once more. I work to clear the breakfast wreckage before we play. She pushes ahead to inspect the pantry and I am torn. Cereal is on the floor. Cereal is on her hands. Cereal bits are in her hair.
This Monday marks the start of the grind. The emails are mounting, and the race is back on. As I crawl about chasing the little O's, the curl-framed face meets mine and grins.
The mess is proof that life is happening. Amid the crumbs, the pure joy of living looks right back.
Pause. Breathe. Look Deeper.
Refuel.

And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them.

But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms.

**[I believe we have not seen a political moment like this since Thomas Jefferson dismantled the Federalists. I mean that seriously.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckr2O3CAUhZ8Gd4z48WBTuIhkudsU0SgpEQPX9tUasADvZt8-8kyS7bf9dHT0cbi_XsyLxQ3j8t0GGHKdTS4mfOwZPLqKKc4p1xUC-go5GMGEokxT3hrrKr6BaW3jB--85a6BgXe9llr3om_WobNWca1Bc2mZ4vaqufKOSc94x3olGhzOPqZ5y6-SievFC-FAMOH5_c5nDqRldoNcLxn2476hs7Ha8jqn7ODiUmi2Ya11L0R-I2IiYirgjgyXd4wZ_JkgYoq5OCKmJe10Txu6D2pLgVICxErjgnHJ6FYKdLdniZyOGkwAj0cgcoRgcSNCnbCkIzsgckwimDP9oNUROf64TfTfY_5yZ8NucYlEjp_6T4NPgbIm90rjYv6LmKfvsyLFCrESOc5H9NliwbgQoWyoeyp4_g-RY_skLZEjZ4wIlc8V8hmVY80HEKHgt6noiRwfkh3j5najP28Xzru216ZyLZRSkl67a5MHv7_jtmFRHWnZci7wWLt-8UDeBvEnAAD__0NVzVk)**

That is how consequential this moment is.

But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically.

__The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports.__

You name it, they are on the wrong side of it.

And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in.

I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either.

clean_body: We in the Senate don't have the money budgeted for Texas Friend, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Peter, it’s been a tough year. Ever since Donald Trump set off an unprecedented mid-decade gerrymandering crisis, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee has been in overdrive. We’ve used every tool at our disposal to fight back and level the playing field. **As we approach the next phase of this fight at the ballot box, one question I keep hearing from supporters is,[_“Do my $5 donations really help?”_ My answer couldn’t be clearer: Absolutely.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139173109/646481401/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGOathRemarksNOR_email_20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_campaign=AGOathRemarksNOR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI3NmZjMjJmLTUxYjAtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TyRSB9rfwG7EqkL5pb8kuzWCMXoXQkdV_a2PbkEz-Hw=)** I’ve held a lot of important titles over my life — Attorney General, Chief Judge, Deputy Attorney General, U.S. Attorney — but **I now hold the most important title of all of them:_American citizen._** The power we have as American citizens is too often underestimated and minimized. A $5 donation viewed in isolation may not seem significant. But if everyone reading this email came together with $5 contributions, it would fund our work through the rest of the midterm elections. That’s the power that each of us has. I understand that people can be a little pessimistic about whether or not we’re going to be able to stop Republican gerrymanders and get back to a system that’s fair and truly representative. I say history should be our guide. We just celebrated the 250th anniversary of the time a bunch of people got together and decided to take on the mightiest empire in the world to form this nation. I’m sure they had doubts along the way and asked themselves, “Can we pull this off?” We’re celebrating today because they didn’t let it stop them. When women decided that they wanted the right to vote, surely they had doubts about making it happen. I’m sure there were times when Dr. King, John Lewis, and Diane Nash must have thought, “Can we rip down a system of American apartheid?” And yet, they mobilized millions and changed the course of history forever. I always come back to this quote from Dr. King: “The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.” But the reality is, it doesn't bend on its own. It only bends when people like us put our hands on that arc and pull it towards justice. [**And a donation to the cause of defending democracy is one way in which you can put your hand on that arc and pull it.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139173110/646481402/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGOathRemarksNOR_email_20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_campaign=AGOathRemarksNOR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI3NmZjMjJmLTUxYjAtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TyRSB9rfwG7EqkL5pb8kuzWCMXoXQkdV_a2PbkEz-Hw=) **So whether you’re donating $5, making phone calls, writing postcards, or trying to get your friends to the polls — all these small individual actions might seem insignificant on their own. Together, they create a nation. They change the world.** And that’s why I remain optimistic. [**I know that if we are focused, committed, and stay the course, we will ultimately win this fight. So, as we face escalating threats to our democracy, I’m asking you to step up with a donation of $5 or whatever you can give to the National Democratic Redistricting Committee. Together, it adds up to something powerful.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139173111/646481403/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AGOathRemarksNOR_email_20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260914-NDRC-Tier1-AGOathRemarksNOR_&utm_campaign=AGOathRemarksNOR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI3NmZjMjJmLTUxYjAtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMjI0ODJhOWYxZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TyRSB9rfwG7EqkL5pb8kuzWCMXoXQkdV_a2PbkEz-Hw=) Thank you, Eric H. * * *
# Yemen
* **Ansarallah advances toward Marib, captures strategic Red Sea islands:** Ansarallah forces are advancing toward Saudi-backed government-held areas in Yemen, with fierce clashes reported on the outskirts of Marib, the government's strategic oil- and gas-rich stronghold, according to Al Jazeera.
* The group is also advancing in Taiz, where government forces are relying heavily on Saudi airstrikes to prevent the city's capture.
* Separately, Ansarallah captured the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands after hundreds of government-allied forces withdrew, AP reported. The islands lie about 160 kilometers north of Bab Al-Mandab in the southern Red Sea.
* The advances strengthen Ansarallah's position around Bab Al-Mandab--a key route for Saudi oil shipments amid the war with Iran and blockades in the Strait of Hormuz.
* **Ansarallah launches attacks at Saudi air base:** Ansarallah [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/b4f3d406-8174-4513-9f42-e6f9b6cd0e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait in response to more than 300 Saudi airstrikes across Yemen over the past five days, military spokesperson Yahya Saree said Monday.
* Saree said the operation targeted fighter jet hangars, radars, runways, ammunition depots, and other military infrastructure, claiming "direct and precise" hits and significant damage.
* He warned that "any new aggression will be met with broader and more severe operations."
* Saudi Arabia's Civil Defense [issued and lifted](https://substack.com/redirect/382f64e1-5540-4c9d-a804-47578b75da7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) public warnings of potential danger in Khamis Mushait and nearby Abha three times early Monday.
* **WHO: Nearly 3,000 casualties, over 77,000 displaced in Yemen in one week:** At least 504 people were killed and 2,379 wounded across Yemen from September 6 to 12, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/22958633-be27-4c46-8ee1-95acf863beb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the World Health Organization. As of September 12, at least 77,789 people had also been displaced across Taiz, Marib, al-Jawf, Lahj, Hodeidah, Abyan, and Shabwa.
* Nearly half the casualties occurred in Marib, strategic Saudi-backed government-held governorate east of Sana'a.
* Separately, Yemen's Saudi-backed forces said more than 500 of their soldiers were killed and around 1,500 wounded in fighting with Ansarallah along the western coast from August 9 to September 10, while claiming more than 1,000 Ansarallah fighters were killed. The figures could not be independently verified.
* **Over 2,000 Yemenis flee to Djibouti as clashes intensify:** More than 2,000 Yemenis fleeing the fighting reached Djibouti, according to figures released Sunday by the International Organization for Migration (IOM). The number rose from around 1,400 arrivals reported a day earlier by Djibouti's Economy and Finance Minister.
* **Islamic Resistance in Iraq denies role in attack on Saudi pipeline:** The Islamic Resistance in Iraq [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/0fd1c0a9-0d7d-455f-adb6-6dedd2752333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) responsibility for a drone attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline on Saturday, after the Iraqi government said the drones were launched from Iraqi territory.
* The group called responsibility for the attack "an honor we do not claim," criticized the Iraqi government for responding before completing an investigation, and offered to join an official inquiry.
* Iraqi security forces [located](https://substack.com/redirect/ab251c3b-1a03-4967-955f-9da8dec51188?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and seized a drone-launching platform allegedly used in the attack on the pipeline, according to the head of Iraq's Security Media Cell. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi reshuffled military commanders in the country's border regions following the attack, dismissing the Maysan operations commander and provincial police chief.
* Iraq also temporarily [closed](https://substack.com/redirect/5d11aaab-0cdc-43a8-9f93-594122b58da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) three border crossings with Iran--Shalamcheh, al-Shib, and Mandali--after discovering drone launch sites.
* No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.
* **Iran denies interference in Yemen, involvement in attack on Saudi pipeline:** Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei denied that Tehran interferes in Yemeni decision-making, saying Ansarallah is "an independent Yemeni party that takes decisions based on what it considers to be its own interests and priorities."
* Baghaei also rejected claims that Iran was involved in an attack on a Saudi oil pipeline from Iraqi territory, calling them "sheer lies" intended to deepen divisions among regional countries.
* **Reuters: Saudi Arabia has just seven days ' worth of oil stored at Yanbu: **Saudi Arabia has between five and seven days' worth of oil stored in its Red Sea port city of Yanbu, three unnamed sources told Reuters on Sunday, adding that Riyadh also has a smaller amount of oil stored in Egypt.
* Saudi Arabia said it suspended its East-West pipeline after the attack as a "precautionary measure."
* The shutdown of the pipeline, which allows exports to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, could threaten up to 4% of global oil supply.
* **Oil prices top $107 a barrel:** Oil prices rose more than 3% on Monday, with Brent crude futures gaining $3.21, or 3.1% percent, to reach $107.82 a barrel.
* **U.S. officials meet with MBS, Trump claims talks with Ansarallah:** Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) met U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper and discussed the latest developments in the Gulf, Saudi state television reported on Monday.
* Trump, who spoke with MBS on Thursday and reportedly declined to intervene directly against Ansarallah, called MBS "a good friend of mine" when asked about their relationship on Saturday, and told reporters that "everything's going to work out fine and dandy."
* In the same remarks, he claimed that he had received a call from Ansarallah, who he said "don't want to fight" the U.S., and that they were "letting most ships go through" the Bab Al-Mandab strait. Its rules bar the accused from reviewing classified evidence against them or legally challenging how it was obtained.
* Haji Zada, who has never been charged with a crime, "conceded that she is an alien terrorist and waived appeal of the removal order," according to the department, which had alleged she worked to radicalize her son and son-in-law, both of whom were convicted over a plot to carry out an ISIS-inspired mass shooting on Election Day 2024.
* **NSA undergoes historic restructuring under Director Joshua Rudd** : The National Security Agency is set to [undergo](https://substack.com/redirect/50d60774-e0ac-47d1-bac6-38cb2cbb2516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its most extensive internal restructuring since 2016, creating five new organizations at its Fort Meade headquarters focused on artificial intelligence, China, cybersecurity, "warfighting" support, and global intelligence, according to current and former officials briefed on the plan and cited by The Washington Post.
* The initiative, spearheaded by NSA Director and Army General **Joshua M. Rudd** , will place each new division under a "mission director" holding effective deputy director-level authority, with candidates potentially drawn from outside the agency--a prospect one former official said has unnerved NSA insiders, noting the agency is "begging people to come back, especially leaders."
* The elite hacking unit Tailored Access Operations, reconstituted by Rudd and set for a significant budget increase in the new fiscal year, will fall under the global intelligence mission director.
